q: Who spoke the words of Deuteronomy to all Israel in the wilderness?
why: He spoke east of the Jordan.
quote: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel in the wilderness east of the Jordan

q: In Deuteronomy, Moses says, “Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is…”
why: There is only one true God.
quote: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One.

q: In Deuteronomy, Moses says to love the LORD with all your heart, soul, and what?
why: Jesus called this the greatest commandment.
quote: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.

q: In Deuteronomy, to whom did Moses tell parents to teach God's words diligently?
why: Talk about them at home and on the road.
quote: And you shall teach them diligently to your children

q: In Deuteronomy, where did Moses tell Israel to write God's words?
why: They should see them every day.
quote: Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates.

q: In Deuteronomy, Moses says man does not live on bread alone, but on what?
why: Jesus quoted this when tempted.
quote: man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.

q: In Deuteronomy, what food did Moses remind Israel God gave them when hungry?
why: Their fathers had never known it.
quote: and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat

q: In Deuteronomy, what did Moses say did not wear out during forty years in the wilderness?
why: God cared for every need.
quote: Your clothing did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.

q: In Deuteronomy, Moses tells Israel to be strong and courageous, for God will never do what?
why: God goes with His people.
quote: He will never leave you nor forsake you.

q: In Deuteronomy, whom did Moses call before Israel and tell, “Be strong and courageous”?
why: Joshua would lead them into the land.
quote: Then Moses called for Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous

q: At the end of Deuteronomy, which mountain did Moses climb to see the promised land?
why: God showed him the whole land.
quote: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo

q: At the end of Deuteronomy, God let Moses see the promised land, but what could he not do?
why: Moses died in Moab.
quote: I have let you see it with your own eyes, but you will not cross into it.

q: How old was Moses when he died, as told at the end of Deuteronomy?
why: His eyes were still not weak.
quote: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died

q: In Deuteronomy's Ten Commandments, whom are we told to honor?
why: So that your days may be long.
quote: Honor your father and your mother

q: In Deuteronomy, after reminding Israel He brought them out of Egypt, what does God command first?
why: God alone deserves worship.
quote: You shall have no other gods before Me.

q: In Deuteronomy, which day did God tell Israel to keep holy?
why: It was a day of rest.
quote: Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy

q: In Deuteronomy, where did Moses say Israel had tested the LORD?
why: Jesus quoted this verse when tempted.
quote: Do not test the LORD your God as you tested Him at Massah.

q: In Deuteronomy, what did Moses say Israel had lacked during forty years in the wilderness?
why: God was with them.
quote: The LORD your God has been with you these forty years, and you have lacked nothing.

q: In Deuteronomy, why did God say He did not choose Israel?
why: They were the fewest of peoples.
quote: The LORD did not set His affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than the other peoples

q: In Deuteronomy, Moses promises Israel will find God if they seek Him with all their what?
why: God is found by those who seek Him.
quote: you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.

q: In Deuteronomy, how long did Moses say he stayed on the mountain to receive the stone tablets?
why: He ate no bread and drank no water.
quote: I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

q: In Deuteronomy, what happened to the first stone tablets of the law?
why: God wrote the words again.
quote: the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke

q: In Deuteronomy, what wood did Moses use to make the ark for the new tablets?
why: The tablets were placed inside.
quote: So I made an ark of acacia wood

q: In Deuteronomy, how were Israelites told to treat the poor and needy?
why: There would always be poor in the land.
quote: that is why I am commanding you to open wide your hand to your brother and to the poor and needy in your land.

q: In Deuteronomy's law, who should get a sheaf of grain forgotten in the field?
why: God blesses the generous.
quote: It is to be left for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow

q: In Deuteronomy, after setting life and death before Israel, what did Moses urge them to choose?
why: So they and their children may live.
quote: Therefore choose life, so that you and your descendants may live

q: In the Song of Moses in Deuteronomy, what does Moses call God, whose work is perfect?
why: God is solid and faithful.
quote: He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just.

q: In Deuteronomy, Moses says the eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are what?
why: God holds His people up.
quote: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms.

q: When Moses died, why was Joshua filled with the spirit of wisdom?
a: Moses had laid hands on him
why: Israel then obeyed him.
quote: Now Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him.

q: After Moses died, how long did the Israelites grieve for him?
why: They mourned in the plains of Moab.
quote: The Israelites grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days

q: In Deuteronomy, how many days' journey is it from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea?
why: Israel took forty years instead.
quote: It is an eleven-day journey from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea by way of Mount Seir.

q: In which year of the wilderness journey did Moses proclaim the words of Deuteronomy?
why: It was the eleventh month.
quote: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month

q: From Mount Nebo, Moses stood on the top of which peak facing Jericho?
why: God showed him the whole land.
quote: to the top of Pisgah, which faces Jericho.

q: According to Deuteronomy, what does no one know about Moses?
why: God Himself buried him in Moab.
quote: and no one to this day knows the location of his grave.

q: In Deuteronomy, how did the LORD know Moses, unlike any later prophet?
why: No prophet rose like Moses.
quote: whom the LORD knew face to face

q: In Deuteronomy, how many times a year were Israel's men to appear before the LORD?
why: At three great feasts.
quote: Three times a year all your men are to appear before the LORD your God

q: In Deuteronomy's law, what must you build around the roof of a new house?
why: So no one falls from it.
quote: you are to construct a railing around your roof

q: In Deuteronomy, Moses says God will raise up for Israel a prophet like whom?
why: Israel must listen to him.
quote: The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers.

q: In the Song of Moses, God caring for Israel is compared to what bird stirring its nest?
why: God carried them on His wings.
quote: As an eagle stirs up its nest and hovers over its young

q: In Deuteronomy, where did Moses tell the Levites to place the Book of the Law?
why: It would stand as a witness.
quote: Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God
